name: Unsplash
description: Find and use high-quality, free images from Unsplash. Your visual companion for creating websites, blog posts, presentations, and more.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Unsplash to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Unsplash to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.unsplash.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Unsplash MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unsplash provides these MCP tools: SearchCollections, SearchIllustrations, SearchPhotos, and SearchUsers.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Unsplash?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Unsplash in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Unsplash requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Unsplash is developed by Unsplash. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
